violation_type.title: Telephone Numbers Posted - Poison Control (26 TAC §747.403(2))
violation_type.typical_finding: Opration did not have emergency number listed for poison control.      This was corrected at inspection when permit holder created a new list of emergency contacts, including the number to poison control and posted the list.
